findings.detail: Issuer_name was populated with schedule headings and separate row attributes instead of the clean issuer name.

rationale: C206 is confirmed by raw source table 10. The filing presents issuer names as clean Investments-column cells, while Type, Reference Rate and Spread, Interest Rate, and Maturity Date are separate columns and investment/category labels are separate heading rows. The extracted issuer_name concatenates those headings and separate attributes into the issuer field, so the flag is a real data error.
